run_vasp_input_generation: run the script to generate VASP input files for the top k adsorbate-slab configurations from a sorted cache
run_single_point_vasp: run the script with the --sp flag to generate VASP single point calculation input files
run_relaxation_vasp: run the script with nsw 2000 to generate VASP relaxation input files for top k configs
review_VASP_FLAGS: review the VASP_FLAGS dictionary to understand default DFT parameters like encut, ediffg, and xc functional
review_write_vasp_input_files: review how write_vasp_input_files is called with atoms, output directory, and vasp_flags to generate VASP inputs
